title: Beyond the 956: Virginia man charged with taping his wife to a chair in the basement so he could watch football
excerpt: Richmond police say Terry Ward, 64, admitted he taped his wife to a chair in the basement so he could watch Sunday night football upstairs. He is charged with felony abduction and misdemeanor assault on a family member.
content:
🌎 BEYOND THE 956

RICHMOND, Va. — A 64-year-old Richmond man is facing a felony charge after police say he taped his wife to a chair in the basement of their home so he could watch football upstairs.

Richmond police responded to a domestic call at about 11:30 p.m. on Sunday, October 11, 2026, at a home in the 2200 block of Maplewood Avenue. According to the criminal complaint, Ward's wife told officers she had been restrained to a chair in the basement for roughly 30 to 45 minutes. Officers reported finding marks and tape residue on both of her arms.

Per the complaint, Ward admitted to officers that he tied his wife to the chair and put her in the basement so he could watch that night's football game — the Sunday Night Football broadcast — upstairs in peace.

Ward is charged with felony abduction and misdemeanor assault on a family member. His arraignment and bond hearing were continued earlier this week, and his next court date is November 10, 2026, in Richmond Juvenile and Domestic Relations District Court.

The case drew national attention after Virginia Statewide Incidents posted the complaint details on Instagram, and WorldStar's post about the arrest was shared widely on Wednesday. The charges are allegations, and Ward is presumed innocent unless and until he is convicted in court. His wife has not been publicly identified in reporting on the case, and Webb Watch 956 is not naming her.

If you or someone you know is experiencing domestic violence, the National Domestic Violence Hotline is available 24/7 at 1-800-799-7233.

Sources: Richmond Police Department criminal complaint as reported by Virginia Statewide Incidents; Dexerto, Oct. 21, 2026; Dangerous Minds, Oct. 21, 2026; WorldStar (@worldstar) on Instagram, Oct. 21, 2026.
